'''''A Study of Men, Women and the [[One Power]] Among Humans''''' is an [[Ogier]] book written by the Ogier author [[Ledar]], son of [[Shandin]] son of [[Koimal]], and, according to [[Loial]], reports on how [[After Breaking]] [[Aes Sedai]] treat men who can [[channel]]. In terms of Ogier time, the book is relatively recent, having been written a scant 300 years ago.{{ref/book|6|54}}
